entities.summary: The Battle of Tacuarí was a battle in Southern Paraguay between forces sent by the Junta of Buenos Aires under the command of General Manuel Belgrano, and Paraguayan troops under Colonel Manuel Atanasio Cabañas, at the service of the Council of Regency.
